spotyou_not_loading.root_cause: Step2MainInfo.tsx (line 63) used `d.points || []` to parse the /tag-points/mine API response. However, the API returns a plain JSON array (not {points: [...]}), so d.points is undefined and setSpots([]) is called, showing empty state.
spotyou_not_loading.reproduction: Login as coach, go to /products/create, select category/tag, go to step 2, activate Par séance - SpotYou list shows empty even though coach has SpotYou pt_demo003
spotyou_not_loading.fix: Changed to `Array.isArray(d) ? d : (d.points || [])` in Step2MainInfo.tsx line 63
spotyou_not_loading.same_bug_in: Step6SpotYouLink.tsx line 31 (dead code, same pattern d.points || [])
spotyou_not_loading.impact: Coach could not select a SpotYou in session mode → blocked from proceeding to step 3
